title: SJT Classroom & Lab Locations
question: Where is SJT (Silver Jubilee Tower) and how are rooms numbered?
answer: Silver Jubilee Tower (SJT) is located on the northern side of the main campus, adjacent to the Technology Tower (TT). SJT has 8 floors (G to 7). Room numbering follows: SJT-Gxx for Ground Floor, SJT-1xx for 1st Floor, SJT-4xx for 4th Floor, SJT-7xx for 7th Floor. The AI Innovate-A-Thon venue SJT-G07 is on the ground floor near the main porch entrance.

title: Technology Tower (TT) & MB Locations
question: Where are Technology Tower (TT) and Main Building (MB)?
answer: Technology Tower (TT) is directly opposite SJT across the central academic quad. Main Building (MB) is located near Gate 1 and houses central administrative offices, the Admissions office, and Dean offices. Anna Auditorium is situated behind TT near the Foodys cafeteria.
source: VIT Campus Map & Directory, Doc Ref: VIT-DIR-2026

title: Computing & Engineering Lab Timings
question: What are the general computing and engineering lab timings at VIT?
answer: Academic computing labs in SJT and TT operate from 8:00 AM to 7:30 PM on official working days (Monday through Friday). Evening special practice lab access is available from 7:30 PM to 10:00 PM with valid faculty/proctor approval and student ID verification.

title: Central Library Reading Hall & Digital Resource Timings
question: What are the Central Library and Digital Library timings?
answer: The Central Library operates from 8:00 AM to 12:00 Midnight on all working days. During Continuous Assessment Tests (CAT) and Final Assessment Tests (FAT), the Ground Floor Reading Hall remains open 24/7. Digital resource browsing and book checkout counters close at 9:00 PM.

title: Riviera, Gravitas and Club Event Registration Procedure
question: How do students register for co-curricular and cultural events or hackathons?
answer: Event registrations are conducted through the VTOP Portal under the 'Events & Fest' tab, or via the official VIT Riviera / Gravitas portals. Select the event, review eligibility/team criteria, complete any fee payment via the integrated payment gateway, and download your registration QR slip for entry verification.
source: VIT Office of Students Welfare (OSW) Event SOP 2026

title: FFCS (Fully Flexible Credit System) Course Registration
question: How does the FFCS course registration process work?
answer: FFCS registration occurs at the beginning of each semester on VTOP. Students select theoretical/lab courses, preferred time slots (e.g., A1, B1, etc.), and course instructors according to their CGPA-assigned time window. Mock registration is held 48 hours prior to the live window.

title: Proctor Meeting & Leave Approval Procedures
question: How do I schedule a proctor meeting or apply for hostel leave?
answer: Proctor meetings can be scheduled during designated weekly proctor hours or via VTOP messaging. For hostel outpass and weekend home leave, submit your application on VTOP Hostel Portal at least 24 hours prior. Automatic SMS/email OTP confirmation will be forwarded to registered parents before approval.

title: Lost and Found Property Desk
question: What is the procedure if I lose or find personal items on campus?
answer: All lost and found items must be reported to the Campus Security Central Control Office located near Gate 2 or the Student Support Helpdesk at MB-G12. Present your student ID to claim verified items. Lost ID cards can be re-issued by applying on VTOP under 'Services > ID Card Reissue'.

title: Health Centre & Emergency Medical Support
question: Where is the Campus Health Centre and what are emergency medical procedures?
answer: The VIT Health Centre is situated opposite the outdoor sports stadium near the Mens Hostel Block. It operates 24/7 with resident medical officers, observation wards, and a free basic pharmacy. For on-campus emergency ambulance transport, dial internal extension 1100 or call 0416-220-2100 immediately.
source: VIT Health Centre SOP & Emergency Services 2026

title: WiFi Access & CTS IT Support Desk
question: How do I connect to campus WiFi and resolve network access issues?
answer: Connect to 'VIT-Student' SSID using your 8-character registration number and VTOP password. To register new laptops or smartphones, visit the Centre for Technical Support (CTS) portal at wifi.vit.ac.in. If connectivity issues persist, visit the CTS Helpdesk at TT-G20 or email cts@vit.ac.in.
